title: Super op autofarm best
features:
[Slasher Blade Loot]

[Main]
• Auto Farm Toggle + Keybind (Default: F)
• Auto Farm Style Dropdown (Selected, Nearest, Lowest HP)
• Mob Select Dropdown (Multi-Select Mobs)
• Auto Refresh Mobs Toggle (Default: ON)
• Refresh Mobs Button
• Teleport Method Dropdown (Default, Tween, Circle TP)
• Attack Style Dropdown (Safe, Normal, Robust, Hard, Extreme)
• Teleport Distance Slider (1-15)
• Tween Speed Via Distance Toggle
• Tween Speed Slider (100-500)
• Circle TP Distance Slider (3-15)
• Circle TP Speed Slider (1-35)
• Height Offset Slider (-5 to 10)
• Avoid Obstacles Toggle (Default: ON)
• Dodge Randomness Slider (0-20)
• Radius Variation Slider (0-5)
• Dynamic Vertical Dodge Toggle (Default: ON)
• Farm Notifications Toggle (Default: ON)

[Safe Mode]
• Safe Mode Toggle
• Min HP % to Farm Slider (1-100)
• Max Mobs in Range Slider (1-10)
• Min Distance to Mob Slider (3-20)
• Slow Attack in Safe Mode Toggle (Default: ON)
• Safe Mode Attack Delay Slider (300-2000 ms)
• Use Tween Only in Safe Mode Toggle (Default: ON)
• Safe Mode Tween Speed Slider (50-300)
• Force Avoid Obstacles Toggle (Default: ON)
• Force Dynamic Dodge Toggle (Default: ON)
• Safe Dodge Randomness Slider (0-25)
• Safe Radius Variation Slider (0-7)
• Safe Height Offset Slider (-3 to 12)

[Hatch]
• Auto Hatch Toggle
• Select Eggs Dropdown (Multi-Select)
• Hatch Amount Slider (1-3)
• Hatch Notifications Toggle (Default: ON)

[Skills]
• Auto Use Skills Toggle
• Select Skills Dropdown (Multi-Select)
• Skill Delay Slider (100-2000 ms)
• Rotate Skills Toggle
• Prioritize Strong Skills Toggle
• Max Skills Per Cycle Slider (1-10)
• Refresh Skills Button
• Auto Upgrade Skills Toggle
• Select Skills to Upgrade Dropdown (Multi-Select)
• Skill Upgrade Delay Slider (1-60 s)
• Skill Upgrade Notifications Toggle (Default: ON)

[Auto Loot]
• Auto Collect Toggle
• Collect Method Dropdown (Teleport, Walk)
• Collect Aura Toggle
• Collect Aura Range Slider (10-200)
• Collect Delay Slider (10-1000 ms)

[Combat]
• Auto M1 Toggle
• M1 Delay Slider (10-500 ms)
• Kill Aura Toggle
• Kill Aura Range Slider (5-50)
• Kill Aura Delay Slider (10-500 ms)
• Use Skills in Kill Aura Toggle
• Kill Aura Notifications Toggle
• Focus Lowest HP First Toggle

[Upgrades]
• Auto Upgrade Stats Toggle
• Upgrade Mode Dropdown (Priority, Smart, Balanced, Equal)
• Stat Priority 1/2/3 Dropdowns
• Defense/Damage/Health Max Points Sliders (0-1000)
• Upgrade Delay Slider (100-3000 ms)
• Upgrade Notifications Toggle (Default: ON)
• Auto Refresh Stats Toggle (Default: ON)
• Upgrade Only at Max Points Toggle
• Batch Upgrade Size Slider (1-50)
• Min Points to Upgrade Slider (1-100)
• Manual Upgrade Buttons (+1 Defense/Damage/Health)
• Stats Information Labels (Available, Defense, Damage, Health)

[Statistics]
• Session Statistics Tracking
• Killed Mobs Counter
• Total Upgraded Counter
• Defense/Damage/Health Upgraded Counters

& Much More
